<template>
    <Teleport v-if="ready" to="#app-bar-actions">
        <v-btn
            variant="text"
            prepend-icon="mdi-logout"
            @click="logout"
        >
            Đăng xuất
        </v-btn>
    </Teleport>
</template>

<script>
export default {
    data() {
        return {
            ready: false
        }
    },

    mounted() {
        this.ready = true
    },

    methods: {
        logout() {
            this.send({
                payload: "LOGOUT"
            })
        }
    }
}
</script>
